|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Leave Them To Me (V)]]. Other versions: [[Leave Them To Me (V)]] (Original), [[Leave Them To Me (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Leave Them To Me (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, the current text). The image is the Players Committee card image (full card with art and lore; slip number D18 and the Virtual Shields icon instead of the sheet slip's 22 and Virtual Block 6 icon; bottom strip “Leave Them To Me (Ref III)”). How these versions came about (Holotable data, the PC website card list, the Master List and the PC card images) is told in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].
* '''Original''' ([[Leave Them To Me (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>, and in the revised copy (PDF dated 20 April 2010; slip #22)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1-revised">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet], revised copy (PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 4, slip 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Plays on table. At opponent's Dantooine and Subjugated planet sites, your Imperials are deploy -2 and your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent. Your game text at opponent's <>Swamp and <>Jungle is canceled. Your characters present at opponent's <>Forest are immune to attrition.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Leave Them To Me (V) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 12 February 2013)<ref name="cl-1261_21-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VShieldsType), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064820/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VShieldsType.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130212003929/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VShieldsType.html 12 February 2013] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Plays on table. At opponent's Dantooine and Subjugated Planet sites, your Imperials are deploy -2 and your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent. Your game text at opponent's <>Swamp and <>Jungle is canceled. Your characters present at opponent's <>Forest are immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' “Subjugated planet” became “Subjugated Planet” (capital P). The list writes ◇ as “<>” (notation).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee card image, dated 25 February 2013 on the PC image server<ref name="srv-VirtualDS-Dark">Players Committee card image server, directory listing of <code>cardlists/images/starwars/VirtualDS-Dark/large/</code>, every card image dated 25 February 2013: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818035235/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/VirtualDS-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019]. The files are byte for byte the ones still served today (research R6, 10–11 November 2026).</ref>: “Plays on table. At opponent's Dantooine and Subjugated planet sites, your Imperials are deploy -2 and your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent. Your game text at opponent's <>Swamp and <>Jungle is canceled. Your characters present at opponent's <>Forest are immune to attrition.” The server date is the date of a bulk upload of the whole folder: the image may have been made earlier, but it is placed at the date it can be shown to exist (Bill, 11 November 2026). '''What changed:''' “Subjugated Planet” became “Subjugated planet” again: word for word the original text. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Leave Them To Me (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 18)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=18, page 18. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=18 Internet Archive]</ref> and the Virtual Shields sheet (PDF dated 21 May 2013)<ref name="vshields">Players Committee Virtual Shields sheet [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf#page=2 vshields.pdf] (PDF dated 21 May 2013), page 2, slip 15 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180941/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Plays on table. At opponent's Dantooine and Subjugated planet sites, your Imperials are deploy -2 and your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent. Your game text at opponent's <>Swamp and <>Jungle is canceled. Your characters present at opponent's <>Forest are immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' nothing: word for word the original text and PC-E2. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
